tagline: A warm, working storefront for a houseplant nursery.
description: A complete, working shop for a houseplant nursery: a real catalogue of easy-care starters, statement plants, pots, tools and a monthly plant subscription, with categories, collections, a bespoke plant PDP and a merchandised home page.
